purpose: Teach: 今や/いったん/実物/新品/ため息/吹く/丸い/酷い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、今や、絶対、部長、絶対、なんだよね
lines.en: Riku, you're actually becoming captain for real, aren't you?
lines.style: Bright, teasing admiration. Quick tempo on the opening. Warm lean-in on his name. Pride underneath the surface-level sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試合前、本気で、絶対、いったん、絶対、休憩、絶対、しようぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Before the match, let's actually take a real break, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. Steady pacing. A gentle anchor — not lecturing, just suggesting what they both need. Slight softness when he says her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、図鑑の、絶対、実物、絶対、博物館で、絶対、見たんだよね、リク
lines.en: Wait — you actually went and saw that animal from the picture book at the museum, didn't you?
lines.style: Sudden realization dawning. Slight lift in pitch on the opening. Genuine curiosity, almost delighted that he really did it. Conversational warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、新品、絶対、のスニーカー、絶対、お洒落だぜ、桜
lines.en: Your new sneakers look really sharp, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere compliment. No flourish. Direct eye contact in the voice. The kind of thing he wouldn't normally say out loud but means completely.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ため息、絶対、つかないでよね、リク
lines.en: Don't sigh like that, okay? Come on.
lines.style: Gentle push-back. Soft but firm. Not harsh — like he sees her carrying something and wants her to set it down. Small parenthetical warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 風が、本気で、絶対、ここでも、絶対、吹く、絶対、と、絶対、涼しいぜ、桜
lines.en: The wind here feels nice and cool too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost dreamy. Slower pace. Looking at something beyond the conversation. Noticing small things the way he does. Voice trails off slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、丸い、絶対、メガネ、絶対、よく似合うよ、リク
lines.en: Those round glasses really suit you, you know?
lines.style: Straightforward admiration. Comfortable silence in the pacing. Like he's been thinking about saying this. Simple and true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日の試験、本気で、絶対、酷い、絶対、難しさだったぜ、桜
lines.en: That test today was brutal, honestly.
lines.style: Dry wit with a genuine edge underneath. Light self-deprecation. Pace steady but with a slight wry exhale at the end. Not complaining — observing.
